item.title: Ho Ho Oh No: Ranking Our Top 9 Killer Santas
item.description: SILENT NIGHT, DEADLY NIGHT hits theaters this weekend and we're in the mood to celebrate some slayin' Santas! Check out our full list right here.

item.title: How A BAYWATCH Spinoff Turned David Hasselhoff Into A Monster Fighter
item.description: With a BAYWATCH reboot on the horizon, we got to thinking about the sea monsters, vampires, werewolves, and mermaids from the wonderfully unhinged second (and last) season of BAYWATCH NIGHTS.

item.title: The Alamo Drafthouse Godzilla Popcorn Bucket Is Fit For A King
item.description: The Alamo Drafthouse has turned the King of the Monsters into a popcorn bucket. That’s right! You can now eat your movie snacks right out of Godzilla’s mouth.

item.title: Rejoice, 28 YEARS LATER Part 3 Officially Moving Forward With Cillian Murphy To Star
item.description: In unsurprising but still hugely exciting news, the third 28 YEARS LATER movie has been given the greenlight at Sony, with Cillian Murphy in talks to star.

item.title: The Adams Family Summons The MOTHER OF FLIES In First Trailer For New Haunted Fairy Tale
item.description: The Adams Family are summoning the MOTHER OF FLIES with the first trailer for their new film, which hits Shudder in January.

item.title: Exclusive Trailer: Arrow Video Unleashes EVIL DEAD RISE On 4K UHD
item.description: Mommy's with the (ultra hi-def) maggots now. Check out the exclusive trailer for Arrow Video's upcoming 4K UHD release of EVIL DEAD RISE right here.

item.title: Collect The Whole Sven Squad With New SVENGOOLIE Trading Card Set
item.description: Collect the entire Sven Squad (yes, Kerwyn too!) with MeTV's new SVENGOOLIE Trading Card series.

item.title: 8 New International Horror Films To Unwrap This December
item.description: Norwegian kaiju clashes, time-loop terror from the UK, blasphemous Swedish miracles—and so much more. Follow in Santa's footsteps and travel around the world with these new and upcoming releases.

item.title: It’s Official, Leon S. Kennedy Returns For RESIDENT EVIL REQUIEM
item.description: Yes, the rumors were true - Leon S. Kennedy is officially back as a playable character in RESIDENT EVIL REQUIEM, with Capcom unveiling the first footage of the hero in action.

item.title: DUST BUNNY Review: This Generation’s Gateway Horror Classic Is Here
item.description: Bryan Fuller's feature directorial debut is a stylish monster fable for the ages — and for all ages.
